records.raw_text: GENERAL SAFETY PRECAUTIONS WHILE DOING HOT WORKS

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 1. If for any reasons, the Hot work is not started immediately after issue of the permit, it will automatically ceases to be valid after  2hours from the time of the gas test mentioned in the permit. The permit shall be revalidated again by the issuing authority after following the required check ups including a fresh gas test.

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 2.  Ensure the healthiness of all fire fighting equipments.

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 3.  Hot work permit will be valid only between the time interval period indicated  as above.

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 4.  Any Hot work that extends beyond 18:00 hrs on working day and all Hot works to be performed on holidays are to be approved by DGM concerned.

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 5.  Gas test is to be done only by properly calibrated Explosi-meters. The necessity and periodicity of a retest should be clearly marked in the permit and strictly adhere to. However, a retest is to be necessarily done at every 8 hrs from the previous gas test.

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 6.  The person performing the job shall possession of the permit till the completion of the job. The permit should be produced for inspection at any time.

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 7.  It is the responsibility of the persons performing the hot work to stop the work if any unusual or hazardous situation develops during the performance of the work and inform the same to section head.

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 8.  Contractual workers engaged in the above Hot work shall posses valid safety passes and gate passes.

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 9.  Hot work must be carried out only by qualified persons.

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 10. All equipments used such as welding holder, cables, regulators etc.. shall confirm to BIS.

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 11. Personnel performing cutting and welding and their supervisors must be trained in the safe operation of their equipment, the safe use of the process and emergency procedures in the event of a fire.

records.source_file: gas line hot work permit for 03-06-2022.docx
records.raw_text: 12. All required PPEs shall be worn strictly as per the job requirement.
